title: When the Vector Falls Anew
author: S. M. Halloran
blurb: Hazel Yarrow, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
